name: GoCardless MCP
description: Lets agents look up GoCardless payments, mandates, and payouts, create payments or refunds with confirmation, and get API integration guidance over a hosted MCP.

skills.name: Integration Guidance
skills.description: Answers GoCardless API questions and writes integration code, such as billing requests and hosted payment page redirects.

skills.name: Payment Lookup
skills.description: Looks up payments, customers, mandates, subscriptions, payouts, refunds, and events to check statuses or debug failures.

skills.name: Payment Actions
skills.description: Creates one-off payments, issues refunds, and cancels mandates, with a confirmation preview before money moves.

skills.name: Sandbox And Live
skills.description: Switches the MCP connection between the Sandbox and Live environments so write actions can be tested first.
